newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA PM SEES C/A CONVERTIBILITY BY SEPTEMBER.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA PM SEES C/A CONVERTIBILITY BY SEPTEMBER.

text.p: Romania plans to achieve current account convertibility for its leu currency by September, Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea said on Thursday.
"By the end of August or no later than September, we will remove all the obstacles to achieve current account convertibility," Ciorbea told a news conference.

Romania has limited current account convertibility.Companies are allowed to buy and sell hard currency freely for their current account operations, but individuals are still limited to buying the equivalent of $500 per year.
The central bank also monitors capital flows.
Earlier this year, central bank chairman Mugur Isarescu announced plans to scrap all remaining restrictions on convertible currency purchases by individuals.
